controls.source_trace: External bytes -> canonical/signed representation -> verification -> consumer.
controls.controlled_verification: Change one protected fixture field and inspect rejection before effects.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Encoding/checksums from the same untrusted source do not establish authenticity.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Verification covers consumed meaning and happens before trusted processing.

controls.source_trace: Key source -> allowed signer -> artifact/message purpose -> policy.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a different synthetic authority for an otherwise valid fixture.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A mathematically valid signature is not signer authorization.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Only approved authorities for the intended purpose can produce accepted content.

controls.source_trace: Outer wrapper -> nested decoder -> type resolution/hooks -> privileged use.
controls.controlled_verification: Use source traces and inert type/schema violations.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A signed wrapper does not make unsafe object construction safe.
controls.remediation_acceptance: External bytes cannot select dangerous constructors or hooks outside the constrained data contract.

controls.source_trace: Input schema -> model/DTO mapping -> caller writable fields -> persistence.
controls.controlled_verification: Submit a harmless forbidden property to a controlled record and read it back.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Parsing or ignoring an extra property is not successful mass assignment.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Only permitted properties change; explicit server-managed state remains authoritative.

controls.source_trace: Authenticated content -> time/operation ID -> atomic replay store -> side effect.
controls.controlled_verification: Replay only an operation declared one-time, within controlled scope.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Message authenticity alone does not imply replay resistance.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Duplicate/stale authority cannot repeat an effect where the contract forbids it.

controls.source_trace: Trusted update identity -> download/storage -> verification -> executable load.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect supplied artifacts and benign local installer fixtures.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A source URL alone is not evidence of unsafe updating.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Unapproved/modified bytes reject before load; rollback/downgrade behavior matches policy.
